report_identity.report_title: Orange Sky Golden Harvest Entertainment (Holdings) Limited Annual Report 2023

business_overview.one_sentence: The group is an integrated film entertainment operator focused on cinema exhibition, film and TV programme production, film distribution, advertising and related services in Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan and Mainland China.
business_overview.revenue_model: Cinema ticket receipts, concessions, film and TV rights distribution, theatre/stage operations, promotion and advertising services, agency services and related entertainment services.
business_notes: Film exhibition accounted for 96% of total segment revenue in 2023.
The group had material going-concern uncertainty in the auditor's report.

funds_assets.business_substance: Total deposits and cash before deducting pledged deposits.
Mainland China bank balances subject to foreign exchange control.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Operating lease burden for cinemas and offices.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Sustainable distributable cash profit is not established: 2023 parent net loss, material going-concern uncertainty, high lease burden and continued capital expenditure.

gaps: No company-disclosed necessary operating cash estimate.
2021 cash flow and capex not extracted in this run.
